blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-17"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
network = "none"

[sandbox]
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", enforce = "vm" }

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock start is at -04:00, but no timezone is set, so the sandbox keeps the image's zone (usually UTC), where it reads 13:00; set [sandbox] timezone
cannot tell whether the run crosses midnight in the image's zone: [agent] timeout is not set, so the run's length is the runtime's
